name: SellBridge
description: SellBridge helps Shopee sellers run their listings and read their business from Claude. Connect with a SellBridge account and Claude can inspect sales KPIs and monthly trends, review category and top-product performance, identify low-profit orders, and read inventory, product catalog and orders. Listing work is covered end to end: discover connected stores, look up Shopee categories, attributes, brands and logistics channels, prefill a draft from an Amazon ASIN, check the listing against prohibited and restricted-item rules, calculate a recommended price and the profit at a given price, compose and upload product images, then create a listing and maintain its stock, price, text, SKU, installment tenures and buyer visibility. Every tool is scoped to the tenant the connected account belongs to. Read tools never write; the listing tools that change or remove live Shopee data are advertised as non-read-only and destructive, so the client can ask for confirmation before they run.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SellBridge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SellBridge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sell-bridge.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SellBridge MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SellBridge lists 53 MCP tools, including apply_frame_to_image, calculate_profit_at_price, calculate_recommended_prices, compose_variation_thumbnail, create_listing, create_listing_with_variations, delete_item, get_attributes, get_brands, get_category_summary, get_compliance_rules, and get_dashboard_kpi.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SellBridge?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SellBridge in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SellBridge requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SellBridge is developed by Darumad Co., Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
